items.title: South Korean minister quits after AI cheating scandal engulfs university exams
items.excerpt: South Korea's education minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned, saying he 'failed to prepare adequately' for the university entrance exams after an AI-assisted cheating scandal forced a last-minute crackdown (wifi blocking, doubled supervisors, device alerts).

items.title: Influencer deepfakes used to stoke Canada-US tensions
items.excerpt: A McGill Centre for Media, Technology and Democracy study found about 300 Instagram and TikTok accounts using AI-altered likenesses of real creators, with AI-written scripts, to inflame Canada-US trade-war discourse — thousands of videos and about 20 million views.

items.title: No new curbs on Nvidia chips
items.excerpt: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said no further restrictions on sales of older Nvidia chips to China are needed after the administration moved last week to block China's remote access to the latest semiconductors.

history_match.title: US moves to cut China’s remote access to AI chips

items.title: Back in lower court, Amazon wants to continue suit against AI assistant
items.excerpt: After the Ninth Circuit lifted the block on Perplexity's Comet shopping agent, Judge Maxine Chesney granted Perplexity a discovery stay while weighing its dismissal motion; Amazon argues a new Comet version and agent autonomy change the CFAA 'authorization' question.

items.title: The Role of AI in Enforcing China's Ethnic Unity Law
items.excerpt: An article-by-article reading of China's new Ethnic Unity Law shows how its content-deletion duties (Art. 31), early-warning systems (Art. 52) and minority-language digitalization (Art. 15) depend on AI for policing, learning and enforcement — and extend to generative-AI model providers.

items.title: 李대통령 "AI데이터센터·메모리 수요 더 늘 것…속도가 생명"(종합)
items.excerpt: 이재명 대통령이 울산 SK AI 데이터센터(AIDC) 건설 현장을 방문해 영남권 메가 프로젝트를 점검하며 AI 데이터센터 구축 속도를 강조했다.

items.title: 국내 대학 연쇄 해킹에 중국 해킹 커뮤니티 연관 AI 도구 흔적
items.excerpt: 최근 국내 대학 20여 곳을 겨냥한 해킹 사건에서 중국 해킹 커뮤니티와 연관된 AI 기반 모의해킹 도구의 흔적이 확인됐다.

items.title: "공무원 AI 개발 실험 넘어 행정 현장으로"…정부, 확산 체계 마련
items.excerpt: 정부가 공무원이 AI로 직접 만든 업무 서비스를 다른 기관도 활용할 수 있도록 공유·확산 체계를 마련했다.

items.title: China attackers deployed AI agents that autonomously found and exploited a 0-day to take over a university server
items.excerpt: Amazon CISO CJ Moses reported that suspected China-linked spies used the open-source Cairn agent framework to autonomously find and exploit a MONAI Label zero-day, taking over a server in a campaign against East Asian universities.

items.title: AI 데이터센터 구축 빨라진다…인허가 일괄처리·평가 특례 마련
items.excerpt: 과기정통부가 'AI 데이터센터 산업 진흥 특별법'(내년 3월 시행) 시행령·시행규칙 제정안을 12월 30일까지 입법예고 — AIDC 인정 기준·신고제, 인허가 일괄처리, 비수도권 50MW 이하 전력계통영향평가 면제, AIDC 특구 기준.

items.title: AI Board holds its tenth meeting
items.source: European Commission — Shaping Europe's digital future
items.excerpt: The EU AI Board met 18 November under the Irish Presidency and endorsed new Rules of Procedure: its Chair will now be elected for a two-year term, starting from the next meeting in early March.

items.title: Senator proposes select committee on AI as Democrats hope to move quickly to regulate it
items.excerpt: Sen. John Hickenlooper proposed, in letters to Schumer and Van Hollen, a Senate select committee on AI, with priorities of third-party evaluation requirements, national-security mitigation and accountability rules as Democrats prepare for the January majority.

items.title: Several Member States call on European Commission to propose legislation to better protect copyright from AI
items.excerpt: Fourteen EU member states urged the Commission to propose swift legislation strengthening copyright protection against AI and ensuring fair remuneration for creators. (Off-list outlet: no allowed-domain outlet carried it in the window.)

history_match.title: EU member states finalize Digital Omnibus negotiating stance

items.title: European Commission says it was hacked by attackers using AI tools
items.excerpt: The European Commission confirmed an AI-assisted cyber campaign (linked to the ARTEX AI pentest framework) disrupted internal systems, saying it is taking the necessary steps in response. (Off-list outlet; on-list coverage not verifiable in window.)
